subject: BlueNova onboarding: PO routing, invoice header requirements & Net terms negotiation
messages:
From: Leah Porter <leah.porter@bluenova.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ap@bluenova.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueNova onboarding packet + initial payment terms ask

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is our standard onboarding packet (BlueNova_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf) and a sample invoice template so your AP team can validate headers/fields (Sample_Invoice_Bluenova.xlsx). A few quick notes up front: 

- Our standard commercial terms are Net 60 for new enterprise customers while we finish our cashflow cycle.
- We can offer a 1.25% discount if we enroll in an early-pay program that enables payment within Net 15.

To move forward we need: PO number or PO routing details, the exact invoice header Redwood requires, and confirmation of the billing cadence (Net 30/45/60).

Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept Net 60 as standard? If Net 45 is required, we'd like to discuss a short-run Net 30 for the first invoice to align cashflow.

Attachments: BlueNova_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf, Sample_Invoice_Bluenova.xlsx

Best,
Leah Porter
Head of Revenue Operations | BlueNova Systems
leah.porter@bluenova.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: Leah Porter <leah.porter@bluenova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueNova onboarding packet + initial payment terms ask

Leah —

Appreciate the packet and the sample invoice. A few items from Redwood finance/procurement perspective: 

1) Standard policy: Redwood typically sets vendor terms at Net 45 for new partners on Dedicated/Private contracts. We do this to standardize month-end close and forecasting.

2) PO and routing: We will issue a Redwood PO (format: RDW-<account>-<seq>) once we receive the completed onboarding form and W-9. Please populate the "bill to" with: Redwood Inference, Inc., 101 Market St, San Francisco, CA and include the legal entity line exactly as above on invoices.

3) Invoice header requirements: mandatory fields are PO number, invoice date, invoice number, line item descriptions, unit price, tax line (if applicable), and remit-to banking instructions. Our AP team cannot process invoices missing these fields.

4) Net terms & early pay: We can accept Net 60 only in exceptional cases (requires finance approval). Standard will be Net 45; however, Redwood runs an early-pay program that can accelerate payment to Net 15–30 in exchange for a small discount. If you’re open to an early-pay discount, we can route to the program and front-load payment for the first invoice.

Action items for BlueNova to unblock PO: completed onboarding form, signed W-9 (or local equivalent), remit/banking details, and the first invoice in the agreed header format. Once we have those we’ll generate PO RDW-BLUE-00097.

Looping in Marissa (Procurement) and Karthik (Finance) to confirm the early-pay enrollment workflow and discount thresholds.

Thanks — will wait for the attachments and confirm PO issuance within 1 business day after receipt.

— Sergio Alvarez
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

From: Leah Porter <leah.porter@bluenova.com>

Thanks Sergio — noted. Per your request I attached the signed W-9 (W9_Bluenova_signed.pdf) and the completed onboarding packet.

A few clarifications from our side: 
- We are willing to accept Net 45 for recurring invoices, but given month-end gaps for our Q3 bookings we request Net 30 for the first two invoices (covers first 60 days).
- Regarding the early-pay program: we can drop the discount to 0.75% for payment at Net 15 if Redwood will enroll BlueNova in the early-pay pipeline. If Redwood requires Net 45 as baseline and cannot do Net 30 for the first invoices, we would need to retain Net 60 (our fallback) and escalate to finance.

Attachments: W9_Bluenova_signed.pdf, BlueNova_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf (completed)

Let me know if those docs look good; if so, we’ll expect PO RDW-BLUE-00097 and will submit invoice once we have it.

Best,
Leah

From: sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: Leah Porter <leah.porter@bluenova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueNova onboarding packet + initial payment terms ask

Leah —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the signed W-9; everything looks in order. Per conversation with Finance and Procurement, here’s what we can commit to: 

- PO issuance: RDW-BLUE-00097 will be issued today. Please use that PO number on the first invoice.
- One-time onboarding accommodation: Redwood will accept Net 30 for the first two invoices only (covers your request for initial cashflow). After that, the account will default to Net 45 terms unless Finance approves a standing Net 30.
- Early-pay program: We can enroll BlueNova into Redwood’s early-pay pipeline. The offer: accelerate payment to Net 15 for a 0.75% discount (as you proposed). Enrollment requires submission of bank ACH details to our payment vendor (we’ll share a secure upload link).

Action items (summary):
- BlueNova: submit first invoice with PO RDW-BLUE-00097 and the invoice fields we listed; confirm whether you want to enroll in early-pay (yes/no).
- Redwood (Marissa): will open vendor record and route to AP; please confirm expected payment date windows for Net 30 onboarding invoices.
- Redwood (Karthik): please confirm the secure upload link for BlueNova banking info and the expected timeline to get early-pay live once bank details are received.

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm the PO will be issued and the secure upload link for ACH by end of day? Leah — once you confirm early-pay enrollment we’ll send the DocuSign link for the vendor addendum and the secure upload for banking.

Thanks — welcome aboard.

— Sergio
